turns.text: How many of our 2025 invoice lines are below our price floor?
Which customers account for most of it?
Correction: finance raised the floor to standard cost plus 15% from 1 January 2025. Please redo it.

csvChecks.ask: below_floor.csv with columns customer_id,lines,gap_gbp: each customer with 2025 lines below the corrected floor, the number of those lines and the shortfall in GBP (floor × quantity − pocket value, summed)
